pkgmetadata.longdescription: Framework for building cross-platform desktop applications with Chromium and Node.js, built from source and slotted by major version.

use.flag: Keep -march, -mtune and -mcpu from CFLAGS (unsupported, known to break some components)
Allow building on a PaX-enabled kernel
Enable proprietary codecs like H.264 and AAC in the bundled ffmpeg
Enable screen capture via PipeWire on Wayland
Use the system copy of media-libs/harfbuzz
Use the system copy of app-arch/zstd
Enable hardware video acceleration via VA-API
